These fixtures are synthetic color rectangles generated for Road Tag regression tests on 2026-10-03 using Pillow 12.3.0 and pillow-heif 1.8.0. They contain no real people, real locations or device metadata. QA_PRIVATE_GPS_MARKER is a synthetic EXIF marker only. qa-oriented.jpg has EXIF orientation 6.
# Error recovery fixture

`qa-corrupt.jpg` is plain synthetic text with a JPEG filename. It intentionally fails header parsing and contains no personal data.
